purpose: Test complementary native and adapted-Qwen errors without text/label features.
components: RO native22; UK needs85; fixed selected Qwen88 with study89parity and study90full outputs.
features: Seven native/Qwen score, logit and agreement terms only; invalid Qwen token => abstention.
selection: Five connected same-focal/pair development folds; regularization0.1,1,10,100; rank unchanged gate eligibility then max/sum false reviews then stronger regularization. Final threshold covers all valid OOF and refit development positives. Calibration never selects model or threshold.
gates: Development, OOF and calibration each require >=99% concern recall and <=5% benign review including abstentions per language/kind.
